testPlan.title: Junction: the mod's X and T on a junction with no number yet

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: A new two-lane T: clear + build
test.passLog: a new junction %(no number yet.*the mod's T fitted
test.hint: Pick a two-lane T you have not built on: side road lanes stop short, no turns. Lock it (the card says junction: new). Right-click. Ticks by itself.

test.title: It is the mod's T
test.hint: Look at the T you just built. It is the mod's T pattern, not separate curved turns. PASS if so.

test.title: A new two-lane X: clear + build
test.passLog: a new junction %(no number yet.*the mod's X fitted
test.hint: Same with a two-lane X you have not built on. SKIP if the card already shows a jNN number there.

test.title: Undo puts it back
test.hint: Press undo once. The junction is back as it was before the right-click. PASS if so. Redo if you want to keep it.
